description.p: LazyLlama is a fast, lightweight Terminal User Interface (TUI) client for Ollama with real-time streaming, markdown support, and smart scrolling.

ul.li: Real-time Streaming: Responses are generated live, providing immediate feedback without waiting for complete generation
Markdown Support: Automatic formatting for headers, lists, bold text, and syntax-highlighted code blocks with custom borders
Smart Scrolling: Auto-scroll during streaming with manual override, smooth navigation, and position preservation
Context Management: Maintains conversation history with clear functionality and session persistence
Performance Optimized: Built with Rust for minimal resource usage and maximum responsiveness
Cross-Platform: Works on Linux, macOS, and Windows

description.p: Current release with improved features and bug fixes.
